# See what retainage is costing your business.

> Free construction retainage calculator for contractors and subcontractors. See retainage withheld, unpaid cash, carrying cost, when retainage typically releases, and copy a factual payment follow-up draft.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
